steps.en: Install the bd CLI once, then initialize it inside your project
steps.zh: 装一次 bd 命令行，再在项目里初始化

steps.en: Creates a local versioned database and wires its workflow into AGENTS.md and agent hooks
steps.zh: 建一个本地带版本的数据库，并把用法写进 AGENTS.md 和 agent 钩子

steps.en: Your agent files tasks and records which task blocks which
steps.zh: agent 登记任务，并记下谁挡着谁

steps.en: At every session start, hooks inject the workflow plus saved memories
steps.zh: 每次开新会话，钩子自动注入用法和存下的记忆

steps.en: The agent asks for unblocked work, claims one task, closes it when done
steps.zh: agent 要一份没被挡住的活，认领一条，做完关掉
steps.code: bd ready · bd update <id> --claim · bd close <id>

steps.en: Closing releases what it blocked, so the next ready list follows real dependencies
steps.zh: 关掉的任务放行它挡住的活，下一份清单按真实依赖排

value.en: After every compaction or fresh session the agent resumes from a dependency-aware task list, not a stale scratch file
value.zh: 每次上下文被压缩或重开会话，agent 都从一张懂依赖的任务单接着干，而不是一份过时的草稿

sources: https://github.com/gastownhall/beads README Quick Start (install script, bd init, bd setup claude/codex; bd init writes AGENTS.md and installs Claude/Codex integrations)
README Essential Commands (bd ready, bd create "Title" -p 0, bd update <id> --claim, bd dep add <child> <parent>, bd prime, bd remember) and README mermaid flow (bd close releases blockers)
README Storage Modes (embedded default, data in .beads/embeddeddolt/, single writer)
docs/getting-started/ide-setup.md (hook-enabled agents: bd prime injects full context at session start)
